note: One row per approximated landmark. `def` states how it is measured; run-landmark-plan.mjs measures them and refuses any whose evidence is weak. `drop` means it was never an approximation: the whole parent IS the answer, so the marking comes off and nothing is anchored.

rows.label: Iliac crest
rows.why: iliocostalis lumborum arises from the crest

rows.label: Angle of the sixth rib
rows.why: iliocostalis thoracis inserts on the rib angles

rows.label: Mastoid process
rows.why: longissimus capitis inserts on the mastoid

rows.label: Acetabulum
rows.why: the socket is where the femur meets the hip bone

rows.label: Head of femur
rows.why: the ball is where the femur meets the hip bone

rows.label: Upper end of the femur
rows.why: the upper end is the top of the bone

rows.label: Lesser trochanter
rows.why: psoas major inserts on the lesser trochanter

rows.label: Ischial spine
rows.why: coccygeus arises from the ischial spine

rows.label: Medial malleolus
rows.why: the medial malleolus is the most medial point of the lower tibia (right leg: medial is +X)

rows.label: Lateral malleolus
rows.why: the lateral malleolus is the lowest point of the fibula

rows.label: Popliteal surface of the femur
rows.why: the popliteal surface is the posterior aspect of the lower femur

rows.label: Posterior surface of the tibia
rows.why: the floor of the fossa is the posterior aspect of the upper tibia

rows.label: Apex of the axilla
rows.why: the apex is the gap between the clavicle and the first rib

rows.label: Bicipital groove
rows.why: both heads of pectoralis major insert on the lateral lip of the groove

rows.label: Lumbosacral angle
rows.why: the angle is the L5/S1 junction

rows.label: Body of the pubis
rows.why: pubococcygeus arises from the body of the pubis

rows.label: Ischial spine
rows.why: coccygeus arises from the ischial spine

rows.drop: a vertebral LEVEL, not a feature on the bone — the whole L4 is the answer
the talus IS the keystone — the whole bone is the answer
the sacrum IS the keystone — the whole bone is the answer
